codeReview.summary: The change stays tightly scoped to the live Playwright smoke test and matches the feature intent. It preserves meaningful browser-first coverage by still requiring the page to settle into either a genuinely loaded dashboard or the explicit Google Sheets error state, while reducing flake risk via a modest timeout increase and a single controlled reload fallback.

summary: Reviewed the feature transcript skeleton, handoff, mission context, static-dashboard-worker skill, and commit d3efe66437420f4336d654080d4bbfb73cac2314. The implementation adequately hardens the live-sheet smoke test without weakening the validator contract or introducing blocking issues.
